Crisp, raw, chunky retro presentation. 8-bit pixel art, 256x224 upscaled to 1024x1024, 16-color CGA/EGA palette only Palette: #000000 (Deep space black), #FFFFFF (Bright white — stars, highlights), #AAAAAA (Light grey — surfaces, hull panels), #555555 (Dark grey — shadows, craters), #0000AA (Dark blue — deep space, shadows), #5555FF (Bright blue — atmosphere, energy), #00AA00 (Dark green — continents, vegetation), #55FF55 (Bright green — HUD accents, energy readouts), #00AAAA (Dark cyan — teal planet, ice), #55FFFF (Bright cyan — Uranus glow, frost highlights), #AA0000 (Dark red — Mars base, danger), #FF5555 (Bright red — alerts, engine glow), #AA5500 (Brown — asteroid rock, dust), #FFFF55 (Bright yellow — stars, thrusters, city lights), #AA00AA (Dark magenta — deep space, nebula tint), #FF55FF (Bright magenta — rare highlight, energy pulse) 8-bit pixel art, 256x224 upscaled to 1024x1024, strict 16-color CGA/EGA palette. Chunky spacecraft mid-frame right, approximately 20-24 pixels wide, rear three-quarter view — blocky light grey (#AAAAAA) hull, dark grey (#555555) panel lines, bright cyan (#55FFFF) and white engine exhaust pixels (4-6 pixels). Uranus left side: dark cyan (#00AAAA) and bright cyan (#55FFFF) block-circle, 70-80 pixels diameter, hard checkerboard dither banding. Ice particle sprites foreground: 1-2 pixel white (#FFFFFF) and bright cyan (#55FFFF) single pixels scattered in loose cluster. Background: dark magenta (#AA00AA) block-dither to black — deep terminal purple. Bright cyan glow from planet: sparse checkerboard dither in surrounding zone. 25-35 white/cyan star pixels. No anti-aliasing, ANSI block-art feel.
